features.name: HTTP server + processing engine
features.detail: ~7,400-line PowerShell HttpListener bound to 127.0.0.1:6969; hosts static UI + ~80 /api/* routes. Version stamp $AutoPdfVersion = 2026.06.15. PS 5.1 + 7 compatible.

features.name: Native launcher
features.detail: Idempotent C# stub compiled with built-in csc.exe; pings /api/status, starts server hidden with AUTOPDF_NO_BROWSER=1, shows splash, opens browser. Embedded multi-size .ico.

features.name: Health / version probes
features.detail: /health returns {status:ok, service:autopdf, port}. Both routes bypass the access-PIN gate for monitoring.

features.name: Access PIN gate
features.detail: accessPin in autopdf-settings.json gates all routes except health/version; protects the Cloudflare tunnel exposure.

features.name: Caching headers / asset versioning
features.detail: Send-File emits Cache-Control: no-store / Pragma: no-cache / Expires: 0; app.js cache-buster token bumped per change (currently ?v=20260624a) so stale UI cannot recur.

features.name: JSON serialization depth
features.detail: Send-Json forces -Depth 10 globally; default depth-2 silently truncated nested arrays (regression caught by the test suite).

features.name: Single-page UI shell
features.detail: ~114 KB single page; 7 tabs (Converter, Splitter, Smart Mapping, Workflow, Scheduler, Index Creator, Settings) plus About/Help. No framework, no build.

features.name: All front-end logic
features.detail: ~5,600-line vanilla JS; collectSplitConfig / idxCollectConfig / buildZoneNamePayload drive every panel. State persisted in localStorage.

features.name: Styles
features.detail: ~38 KB hand-written CSS; flex panes with flex-shrink:0 on .zone-canvas-stage so the click canvas stays 1:1 with the rendered page at any zoom.

features.name: Branding assets route
features.detail: Bounded static route serving the blue AutoPDF badge in About/Help; embedded app icon.

features.name: Conversion runner
features.detail: Batch convert input folder; Office via COM, images/text/Markdown to PDF. Progress + log via /api/log, /api/download-log.

features.name: Scanner capture
features.detail: Device id naps2:<driver>|<name> dispatches to bundled NAPS2 (TWAIN/ESCL); otherwise native WIA. Backend isolated for license swap.

features.name: Bundled-engine OCR
features.detail: Tesseract produces a searchable text layer for scanned/image PDFs; multi-language select in Settings + Splitter.

features.name: Split runner
features.detail: 9-panel rule-based splitter: zones, patterns, bookmarks, page ranges. Renders pages via /api/split-render-page.

features.name: Per-section CSV writer
features.detail: Appends one row per split section; headers from $csvHeaders. Accumulates rows for the XML emit site.

features.name: Word bbox extraction + cache
features.detail: Reads word boxes via Poppler pdftotext -bbox; fixed a PS case-insensitive variable bug (x0/y0/x1/y1) that zeroed all box sizes; per-(path+mtime) bounded cache.

features.name: Tagged-zone resolution
features.detail: Re-finds the label on each section's pages and pulls the value beside it, falling back to the marked value rect; previewed via /api/tagged-zone-resolve, captured via /api/region-anchor.

features.name: Template CRUD
features.detail: Templates are JSON in Application/templates/*.json; e.g. BU Procurement (zones), BU Registrar (rules), BU Special Collections (rules).

features.name: Three-pass extraction runner
features.detail: Pass order zones -> regex_match -> ai_extract, each pass priming the next. tagged_zone branch re-resolves anchors per document.

features.name: Batch apply over a folder
features.detail: Accepts autoMatch, applyFilenames, aiModel; auto-matches by anchor text/regex, writes one CSV per matched template; ecosystem-exposed entry point.

features.name: Single-PDF verify
features.detail: Runs a template against the loaded sample; accepts aiModel so ai_extract fields are verified; per-field pass/fail.

features.name: Value post-processing
features.detail: currency / date / number / phone / upper / lower / trim normalizers per field.

features.name: Anchor resolution
features.detail: Resolves anchor phrases to page bboxes via Poppler pdftotext -bbox-layout; returns rectangles as page fractions.

features.name: Centralized library
features.detail: ~30 builtin patterns (SSN, EIN, phone, dates, currency, etc.), flagged builtin:true and protected from delete; user-extendable.

features.name: Library API + editor
features.detail: Settings tab search/filter/add/edit/delete with a live Test button; AI-proposed additions can be one-click added.

features.name: Smart Mapping chat
features.detail: Page-range-aware (pageFrom/pageTo, auto window from num_ctx); includes extracted zone text in context; parses <thinking> tags into a separate reasoning log.

features.name: AI field proposal v2
features.detail: Injects the regex library into the prompt; returns fully-configured fields (kind/regex/scope/strategy/format/anchor + rationale), suggested anchor, filename pattern, and proposedLibraryAdditions.

features.name: Specialized model recipe
features.detail: ollama create autopdf-mapper -f ...; SYSTEM block teaches the 3 field kinds + library convention. Settings default ollamaModel = autopdf-mapper:latest, host 127.0.0.1:11434, num_ctx 32768.

features.name: AI on/off + graceful degrade
features.detail: Manual Enable Local AI toggle independent of Ollama detection; AI surfaces stay visible-but-greyed when AI is unavailable.

features.name: Index build runner
features.detail: Builds $columns + $rows from folder tree / filename parts / in-PDF content; writes CSV and optional XLSX (Excel COM). FILENAME leads every index.

features.name: Recipe storage
features.detail: Shared recipe store with the Splitter; ships Basic / Mid / Complex BU demo recipes (30 rows x 5/9/17 cols).

features.name: OnBase XML Index DIP serializer
features.detail: Foundation 24.1 schema: <runRoot> -> <NewDocument> with optional <DocTypeName>, one element per column, repeatable <FilePath>. UTF-8 no-BOM, XML-escaped, empty-keyword skipped. Wired into both Index Creator (format.alsoXml) and Splitter (indexCsv.xml.enabled).

features.name: Config-driven date formatting
features.detail: Normalizes raw filename/content dates (demo presets MM/dd/yyyy); round-trips via row._idxDate in app.js. UI date-format picker still TODO.

features.name: Workflow + Scheduler
features.detail: Chain Split/Convert/AI re-group/Filter/Rename/Blanks/JS; cron-style scheduling on a watch folder. Single-threaded; overlapping Preview+Run can stall it.

features.name: Config export / import
features.detail: Portable settings + recipes + templates + library bundle for moving a configured AutoPDF between machines.

features.name: Tier 1/2 PowerShell tests
features.detail: ~27 API + AI-shape tests in seconds; -WithAi -AiModel autopdf-mapper:latest exercises ai_extract. 27/27 pass once the service is restarted.

features.name: Tier 3 Playwright UI tests
features.detail: UI regression (pre_flight, regex_library, settings, smart_mapping, splitter, workflow); product-agnostic conftest.py/run.ps1 reusable across QI tools.

features.name: QI services + tunnel
features.detail: QI_AutoPDF = manual NSSM placeholder (app runs interactively for Office COM at logon); QI_AutoPDFTunnel = auto-start Cloudflare tunnel; nssm at C:\QIH\engine\bin\nssm.exe.

features.name: PP-OCRv5 ONNX engine (RapidOcrNet)
features.detail: Approved 2026-06-22, not started (resume target 2026-06-28). Second OCR engine via ONNX Runtime + .NET (no Python), engine = tesseract|paddle-onnx, device = auto|cpu|cuda; Tesseract stays default. Preserves zero-install portability.

features.name: Python PaddleOCR prototype (rejected route)
features.detail: Standalone hybrid extractor prototype; NOT referenced by AutoPDF-Server.ps1/app.js. Python/paddlepaddle route rejected for footprint + AVX risk; superseded by the ONNX plan.
